ceu: ✦ The square between the Sun and Pluto

s.k: A day to get in step as a pair.
t: A good day for agreements and serious conversations with those who walk beside you. Be clear and fair.
The square between the Sun and Pluto creates some tension between intimacy and friendships. Today's challenge is teaching you patience.
With Mercury retrograde in your relationships sector, an old matter may come back, and it is worth closing it properly.
s.d: Thank someone who supports you and rarely hears a thank-you.

t: The Moon passes through your area of routine and health. Organising the day is the best way to make the most of it.
The square between the Sun and Pluto creates some tension between relationships and your career. Do not take to heart what has nothing to do with you.
With Mercury retrograde in your daily routine sector, double-check dates, messages and contracts before moving forward.
s.d: Take a real lunch break, without screens.

s.k: A day to create, play and feel.
t: Today your heart is lighter and more playful. It is a good day for romance and for small pleasures.
The square between the Sun and Pluto creates some tension between routine and your horizons. Put off big decisions until the dust settles.
With Mercury retrograde in your romance sector, it is a time to review and correct, not to sign in a hurry.
s.d: Listen to a song you love and let yourself go.

s.k: Look after your nest and the people in it.
t: With the Moon in your house of roots, old memories may return. Welcome them without getting stuck in them.
The square between the Sun and Pluto creates some tension between romance and intimacy. Do one thing at a time and the day will calm down.
With Mercury retrograde in your home and family sector, an old matter may come back, and it is worth closing it properly.
s.d: Light a candle at the end of the day and give thanks for your home.

s.k: The right words open doors today.
t: The Moon livens up short trips and contact with siblings, neighbours and colleagues. A day on the move.
The square between the Sun and Pluto creates some tension between family and relationships. You do not have to choose right now: look for the middle ground.
With Mercury retrograde in your communication sector, double-check dates, messages and contracts before moving forward.
s.d: Give a sincere compliment to someone you come across.

s.k: Security is built in small steps.
t: Today's emotions run through your wallet and through what you consider yours. Protect what you have built, without closing yourself off.
The square between the Sun and Pluto creates some tension between conversations and routine. Be firm, but without hardening your heart.
With Mercury retrograde in your money sector, it is a time to review and correct, not to sign in a hurry.
s.d: Ask for what you are owed, politely and without fear.

t: The Moon passes through your sign today and leaves your emotions close to the surface: it is a day to listen to yourself first and decide later.
The square between the Sun and Pluto creates some tension between money and romance. Breathe before reacting, because haste is the worst adviser today.
With Mercury retrograde in your self-image sector, an old matter may come back, and it is worth closing it properly.
s.d: Before saying yes to someone, ask yourself whether it is also a yes for you.

t: Today sensitivity is high and tiredness may appear. Sleep well and protect yourself from noise.
The square between the Sun and Pluto creates some tension between your image and family. If something goes wrong, it is just an adjustment and not the end.
With Mercury retrograde in your inner life sector, double-check dates, messages and contracts before moving forward.
s.d: Say a short prayer or meditation for your peace.

s.k: The future takes shape in good company.
t: With the Moon in your house of dreams, the future feels closer. Write down a wish and a first step.
The square between the Sun and Pluto creates some tension between your inner life and conversations. Tension is a sign of growth, not of failure.
With Mercury retrograde in your friendship sector, it is a time to review and correct, not to sign in a hurry.
s.d: Invite someone for a coffee or a walk.

s.k: Think of the summit, climb one step.
t: The Moon asks you for responsibility and vision. Think about what you want to build over the coming months.
The square between the Sun and Pluto creates some tension between friendships and money. Say what you feel calmly and without blaming.
With Mercury retrograde in your career sector, an old matter may come back, and it is worth closing it properly.
s.d: Keep a promise you made to yourself today.

t: A day to step out of your mental routine. Try a different path, even a small one.
The square between the Sun and Pluto creates some tension between your career and your image. Hear both sides before you decide.
With Mercury retrograde in your horizons sector, double-check dates, messages and contracts before moving forward.
s.d: Sign up for, or find out about, a course that interests you.

s.k: Let go of what no longer belongs to you.
t: The Moon passes through your deepest area. Emotions arrive with intensity, and with them the wish for truth.
The square between the Sun and Pluto creates some tension between your horizons and your inner life. Protect your peace and choose the battles worth fighting.
With Mercury retrograde in your intimacy sector, it is a time to review and correct, not to sign in a hurry.
s.d: Trust a secret only to someone who has already proved worthy of it.
